rationale: The production roadmap requires provider registry, model registry, council settings, routing and budget enforcement to stop behaving as independent planes. This change introduces a ModelControlPlane facade that registers provider models into ModelRegistry and ModelRouter, validates routing and council assignments against ModelRegistry.model_id, and enforces ModelBudgetManager before selecting a routed model. It is D3 because it adds a public orchestration contract for model selection and governance that future J-flow and council runtime paths must call.

steps: Remove sylion.cognitive.model_control_plane and public export from cognitive/__init__.py.
Keep the ModelBudgetManager unlimited remaining fix and JSON-safe API serialization unless a separate rollback proves the old None contract is required.
Run model_control_plane, model_registry, model_router, model_budget, model_runtime_policy, council_model_policy and provider_catalog route tests twice.
Leave model_control_* SQLite rows inert; do not delete production model governance data during rollback.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that provider registration creates ModelRegistry and ModelRouter entries, routing and council config cannot reference unknown models, budget enforcement runs before model selection, and a budget-blocked primary model falls back to the next registered model.
pre_conditions: ModelControlPlane uses an isolated SQLite database.
Provider definitions include primary and fallback models.
Budgets are configured for both models.
FastAPI ModelControlPlane routes are available through the test client.
steps: Register a provider with two models and a keys_ref.
Verify provider state, ModelRegistry entries, capabilities and ModelRouter selection.
Configure budgets for primary and fallback models.
Configure J1/J2 routing with primary and fallback chain.
Resolve the route and verify the primary model is selected when budget permits.
Record usage that exhausts the primary budget.
Resolve the route again and verify fallback selection with budget_blocked attempt metadata.
Verify routing and council config reject unregistered models.
Verify monitoring budget API remains JSON compliant after internal unlimited budgets return infinity.
Exercise provider, budget, routing, routing resolve, council config and snapshot API routes.
Run the full related model/provider/council test suite twice.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: Every routed model and council assignment references ModelRegistry.model_id, model selection is budget-gated, fallback works after budget exhaustion, and API snapshot exposes one composed control-plane view.
